crusadecraft.task.maintenir_ordre.desc: The marshal holds the countryside: each point of Martial weakens factions and calms revolts.
crusadecraft.task.debusquer_complots.des: The spymaster hunts conspirators: plots, factions and secrets are uncovered three times faster.
crusadecraft.toast.event.body: A decision awaits you (%s day(s)): realm menu, K key.
crusadecraft.event.fx.subject: Character's opinion: %s
crusadecraft.event.default: Applies by default if you do not decide.
crusadecraft.event.gone: This matter no longer awaits an answer.
crusadecraft.event.famine.title: Famine
crusadecraft.event.famine.text: The granaries ring hollow. In the colonies bread is rationed and people grumble against the crown: the mayors want the treasury to buy grain.
crusadecraft.event.peste.title: The fever
crusadecraft.event.peste.text: A malignant fever spreads from house to house. Healers speak of closing the gates and burning the straw beds; meanwhile soldiers fall ill in the barracks.
crusadecraft.event.peste.opt.chaplain: Entrust the sick to the chaplain
crusadecraft.event.prosperite.title: Happy days
crusadecraft.event.prosperite.text: The people are content, the markets overflow and there is singing in the squares at night. Your councillors suggest marking the occasion — or making the most of it.
crusadecraft.event.prosperite.opt.feast: Throw a feast for the people
crusadecraft.event.prosperite.opt.church: Make an offering to the Church
Your chancellor comes to the audience: he asks to sign certain letters alone, "to save time". His rivals see a hand reaching for the seal.
crusadecraft.event.duel.title: A challenge
crusadecraft.event.duel.text: A knight-errant throws down his gauntlet before your marshal and challenges the valour of your arms in front of the whole court.
crusadecraft.event.duel.opt.accept: Let the marshal take up the challenge
crusadecraft.event.duel.opt.refuse: Have the insolent man thrown out
crusadecraft.event.festin.title: Time for a feast
crusadecraft.event.festin.text: The season is right and the court is bored. A great feast would be talked about to the borders — and empty the treasury.
crusadecraft.event.chasse.title: A hunting party
crusadecraft.event.chasse.text: The huntsmen have flushed a great stag in the woods of the demesne. Your councillors wait to know whether you will join the hunt.
crusadecraft.event.pelerins.title: Pilgrims
crusadecraft.event.pelerins.text: A band of pilgrims asks for shelter and passage. They are poor, pious and numerous; the steward points out that they cross your tolls.
crusadecraft.event.marchand.title: A merchant from overseas
crusadecraft.event.marchand.text: A merchant from afar offers silks, spices and a silver astrolabe. He is also looking for a partner in the realm.
crusadecraft.event.brigands.title: Brigands on the roads
crusadecraft.event.brigands.text: Brigands are holding travellers to ransom between your colonies. The mayors want action before the merchants desert the roads.
crusadecraft.event.brigands.opt.ignore: The roads are the mayors' business
crusadecraft.event.recolte.title: A fine harvest
crusadecraft.event.recolte.text: The harvest has been generous. Sheaves pile up and the peasants hope for a harvest festival.
crusadecraft.event.predicateur.title: A preacher
crusadecraft.event.predicateur.text: A barefoot preacher harangues the crowds: he denounces the luxury of the mighty and the tithes. The people listen; the clergy worry.
crusadecraft.event.predicateur.opt.expel: Drive him out of the realm
crusadecraft.event.ralliement.title: The call to arms
crusadecraft.event.ralliement.text: The war drags on. Your captains propose raising new companies: volunteers for gold, or else a forced levy.
crusadecraft.event.heritier.title: The question of an heir
crusadecraft.event.heritier.text: The years pass and the court wonders: who will wear the crown after you? Proclaiming an heir would reassure your vassals.
crusadecraft.event.faction_baisse_impots: Led by %1$s, a court faction demands lower taxes. Its members no longer hide their anger: refuse, and the colonies will stop paying.
%2$s wants to leave the realm. %1$s speaks in its name: the province will govern itself, or rise up.
crusadecraft.event.faction_changement.te: Led by %1$s, a faction demands the dismissal of %2$s, whom it blames for every ill in the realm.
crusadecraft.event.plot_discovered.title: A plot uncovered
crusadecraft.event.plot_discovered.text: Your spymaster has proof: %1$s was preparing a %2$s. The culprit does not yet know you know.
crusadecraft.event.plot_succeeded.title: A plot has succeeded
crusadecraft.event.plot_succeeded.text: The blow has fallen, and nobody saw it coming until afterwards: %1$s was behind this %2$s.
crusadecraft.event.revolt.title: The peasants rise up
crusadecraft.event.revolt.text: In %2$s, hungry and overtaxed peasants have driven out the tax collectors. They will pay nothing more until they are heard.
crusadecraft.event.revolt.opt.wait: Wait for the anger to fade
crusadecraft.faction.baisse_impots.desc: Its members want taxes lowered one step.
crusadecraft.faction.independance.desc: An unhappy province wants to leave the realm.
crusadecraft.faction.changement.desc: Its members want to drive out a councillor they hate.
crusadecraft.intrigue.title: Court intrigues
crusadecraft.intrigue.no_spy: Without a spymaster, you know nothing of what is afoot.
crusadecraft.intrigue.dread.tip: The dread you inspire weakens factions (by half its value).
crusadecraft.intrigue.rumours: Whispers are going round: %s faction(s) forming in the shadows.
crusadecraft.intrigue.power.tip: At %s%% power, the faction issues its ultimatum.
crusadecraft.intrigue.secrets.unknown: Without a spymaster, secrets stay well kept.
crusadecraft.intrigue.blackmail.tip: They will keep quiet for two months — no faction, no plot — but will not forget. Dread +3.
crusadecraft.intrigue.expose.tip: Justice is done in plain sight: prestige +5, but they will hold it against you for a long time.
crusadecraft.intrigue.open.tip: Factions, plots and secrets uncovered by your spymaster.
crusadecraft.toast.faction.title: A faction is forming
crusadecraft.toast.secret.title: A secret uncovered
crusadecraft.chronicle.title: Chronicle of the reign
crusadecraft.news.none: No news of the realms you know.
crusadecraft.chronicle.coalition: A coalition of %s realms forms against the realm.
item.crusadecraft.chroniques.desc: A book that writes itself: the chronicle of your reign.
crusadecraft.chronicles.no_realm: A realm is needed for its chronicles to be written.
